title: Auto-Report Unsupported Files via Taskweave Tool Call

sections.what: Detect skipped/unsupported file extensions (e.g. .docx, .xlsx, .epub) and unparseable/OCR-less scanned files during codesearch indexing, then tool-call or invoke taskweave to create deduplicated parser-support backlog tasks in the codesearch project.
sections.why: Currently scan() skips unknown extensions silently and parse failures only appear transiently in problems[]. Having codesearch (and its LLM interpreter) invoke taskweave turns missing format support into tracked backlog items with sample paths and counts.
sections.how: 1) Aggregate skipped extensions and parse-failure clusters with sample paths and file counts during indexer.scan()/_parse_files(). 2) Add a deduplicating Taskweave reporter helper (check existing tasks via taskweave similar/list before calling taskweave new/set). 3) Expose --report-gaps CLI flag and hook for the LLM file interpreter so unrecognized formats automatically log one canonical task per format/cause.
sections.verify: pytest on a fixture repo with multiple .docx files and an empty scanned PDF emits one deduplicated taskweave report per format/cause and does not create duplicates on repeated runs.

acceptance.text: Aggregate skipped unsupported extensions and parse-failure clusters in indexer output
Add idempotent Taskweave duplicate-checking reporter helper for CLI/MCP tool-calling
Wire interpreter/CLI hook to invoke reporter with sample paths and file counts
Verify deduplication in pytest without creating duplicate tasks across repeated runs
